personality_one_liner: A premium, trustworthy, and visually rich marketplace balancing the elegance of beauty services with the warmth of celebrations.

spacing.rule: Use generous iOS-native padding. Group related elements with md (12pt) and separate sections with xl (24pt) or 2xl (32pt). Primary CTAs are sticky at the bottom with safe area clearance.

do's: Apply frosted glass to the bottom tab bar, floating actions, and sticky headers.
Use glass on hero/featured category cards sitting over image backdrops.
Ensure strong readability by combining blur with a minimum 70% tint layer beneath foreground text.
dont's: Do not use glass for standard list items, form inputs, or standard buttons.

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Seamless entry into the app with a focus on trust and speed.
screens.layout: Minimalist layout with a prominent brand logo, floating inputs, and a sticky 'Continue' button over the keyboard.

screens.name: Onboarding (Location)
screens.purpose: Capture user location seamlessly to customize available services.
screens.layout: Large map interface at the top, a clean search/autocomplete field in a bottom sheet, and quick select options (Home/Work).

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Gateway to all services, clearly splitting Beauty and Celebration.
screens.layout: Header with current location and profile avatar. A prominent search bar. Horizontal scroll sections for categories ('Beauty', 'Celebration'). High-quality image cards for 'Popular Services'. Glass bottom tab bar.

screens.name: Category List
screens.purpose: Browse all services under a specific category.
screens.layout: Sticky glass header with back button. Vertical list of service cards. Each card includes an image on the left, title, starting price, and a subtle 'Book' chevron/icon.

screens.name: Service Detail
screens.purpose: Provide comprehensive details, packages, and pricing for a service.

states.loading: Hero image skeleton and content skeleton.
states.error: Full screen error with retry button.

screens.layout: Hero image with top-down gradient scrim (glass header over it). Content scrolls beneath. Sticky bottom CTA containing 'Starting at ₹XX' and a prominent 'Book Now' button.

screens.name: Provider & Design Browse
screens.purpose: Allow users to pick specific designs or upload their own.

states.empty: Illustration + 'No designs yet' + CTA to request custom.

screens.layout: 2-column Pinterest-style masonry or grid layout for designs. A floating action button (FAB) with glass effect to 'Upload Custom Design'.

screens.name: Booking Flow
screens.purpose: Configure the where, when, and how of the service.
screens.layout: Step-by-step or consolidated form. Segmented controls for ASAP vs Scheduled. Native date/time pickers. Sticky 'Confirm Booking' button at the bottom.

screens.name: Bookings List
screens.purpose: Track current and past service requests.
screens.layout: Sticky header with Segmented tabs (Active, Upcoming, Completed). Clean card list detailing service, date, status pill (using status tokens), and provider.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Manage user account, addresses, and settings.
screens.layout: Avatar and name at the top. Clean list rows for 'Saved Addresses', 'History', 'Support', and 'Logout' with right-pointing chevrons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality guidelines: generous whitespace, high-quality images, and sticky primary actions above the bottom safe area.
Implement the 'gradient-to-dark scrim' for all images where text is overlaid (hero images on Service Details, Category headers). Set gradient stops: transparent at 0% to ≥70% surfaceInverse at 100%.
Implement Glassmorphism (blur over a 70%+ tint) strictly for: bottom tab bar, floating action buttons (FAB), and sticky headers during scroll.
Banned Colors Protocol: Under no circumstances should indigo, violet, blue, or purple be used in the UI. Stick strictly to the warm ruby/rose-gold brand palette.
Every primary button ('Book Now', 'Confirm') inside scrollable pages MUST be fixed at the bottom inside a non-scrolling container or bottom sheet.
For the booking flow, structurally separate 'Where/When' inputs from the 'Payment/Confirm' step based on mobbin research insights.
